title: Best of Barcelona
text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our “Best of Barcelona tour“ on Sunday, November 1, 2026. What made the tour enjoyable was the knowledge and friendliest of our guide, Nilo. Her knowledge of the neighborhoods and her personal folder with the many pictures and illustrations of the sites  were visiting made it easy to understand the site she was explaining to us. We were impressed with her knowledge of the Old City, the Gotha Quarter, Sagrada Familia, Casa Batllo,  Casa Mia and Park Guell. Nilo was extremely friendly and made our tour something to remember. author: jfiesq

title: We had a wonderful time...
text:
We had a wonderful time exploring Barcelona's must-see sights with Alina as our guide. Our family of eight, along with other guests, walked through the Gothic Quarter, took in the views from Montjuïc, went inside the Sagrada Família, and finished at Park Güell. We were picked up and dropped off near our Airbnb on time.

It was a full day, but Alina sequenced everything so efficiently that we made the most of our limited time. Her humor kept the whole group entertained from one stop to the next.

Thank you!
author: AJ_A

title: Solo traveller

title: Great tour with Tatiana
text: Tatiana was a great guide. She gave a lot of information on all the places we visited. She also walked at a reasonable pace so older people like me could keep up. Sagrada Família was amazing. By the time we got to Park Guell, we were really tired. I thought the entrance fee for Park Guell was way too high.

title: Great day trip.
text: Great day trip that included a lot of beautiful stops.  All stops had time well spent and our guide was very knowledgeable.  Bring water for the ride, if coming from Lisbon it is approximately 1 hr 30 mins.
author: Adam_J

title: Best one-day tour of Barcelona
text:
f you have just one day in Barcelona, then this is absolutely the best trip you can take. 
And any tour like is a good guide can make it that much more interesting- and we got the absolute best with Hengameh Ghanavati!
It started with a stop at the Gothic Quarter, a walking tour of the medieval old town of Barcelona; and stops at Montjuic mountain to take in breathtaking views of Barcelona; a stop at Sagrada Familia and then at in Park Guell.
Hengameh brings history to life! She’s very knowledgeable - after all she just completed a PhD in tourism- but more than that, she’s a great storyteller
author: Chandrika_L

title: overwhelmingly beautiful
text: Alberto was our tour guide.  He was friendly and extremely knowledgeable about Sagrada Familia and all of Berlin.  The Sagrada was overwhelmingly beautiful and massive.  You could be in there for hours.  This is a must see site if you visit Barcelona.  We stopped for a late lunch at our own expense.  Bring snacks because it is a long day.
author: Sabrina_C
